title.description: A short manual-tester-facing title for the whole flow, e.g. 'Successful login with valid credentials'.

precondition.description: One sentence describing the state the tester must be in before starting, e.g. 'User is on the login page and not already signed in.'

steps.description: Exactly one entry per input step, in the same order, using the same Number.

action.description: One imperative sentence a manual tester follows, e.g. 'Enter a valid username in the Username field.'

expectedResult.description: What the tester should observe after this step, e.g. 'The Username field contains the entered value.'
